# Archives of Medical Science

> An open-access peer-reviewed medical journal publishing original research across cardiovascular disease, epidemiology, and clinical medicine.

Archives of Medical Science is a peer-reviewed open-access journal that serves as a comprehensive repository for medical research articles. The journal maintains rigorous ethical standards and editorial procedures while providing accessible publishing through an article processing charge model.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-review process
- article processing charge (APC)
- manuscript submission
- editorial board
- ethical standards
- coronary artery calcification
- cardiovascular disease
- Mendelian randomization
- Global Burden of Disease
- medical science research
- journal indexing
- author guidelines
- publication ethics
- academic journal management

## Journal Access & Archives

- [Archives of Medical Science](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com): Homepage for Archives of Medical Science open-access journal
- [Archives of Medical Science - Archive](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Archive): Article repository and archive of published medical science research
- [Archives of Medical Science - Online first articles](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Online-first): Online-first accepted manuscripts pending formal publication
- [Archives of Medical Science - Most read articles](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Most-read-articles,3520.html): Popular and highly-read articles from the journal archive

## Author Guidelines & Submission

- [Archives of Medical Science - Instructions for authors](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Instructions-for-authors,2471.html): Manuscript submission guidelines and author requirements

- [Archives of Medical Science - Regulations of paying article processing charge (APC)](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Regulations-of-paying-article-processing-charge-APC-,4447.html): APC payment regulations and policies for authors
- [Archives of Medical Science - Ethical standards and procedures](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Ethical-standards-and-procedures,2479.html): Publication ethics, research standards, and editorial procedures

## Featured Research Articles

- [Aging and coronary artery calcification: a Mendelian randomization study](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Aging-and-coronary-artery-calcification-a-Mendelian-randomization-study,217629,0,2.html): Research article on coronary artery calcification and aging
- [2025: The year in cardiovascular disease – the year of triglyceride lowering therapies](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/2025-The-year-in-cardiovascular-disease-the-year-of-triglyceride-lowering-therapies,216960,0,2.html): Clinical review on triglyceride-lowering therapies and cardiovascular disease
- [Polish consensus on smoking cessation intervention within lung cancer screening](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Polish-consensus-on-smoking-cessation-intervention-within-lung-cancer-screening,214091,0,2.html): Consensus guidelines on smoking cessation and lung cancer screening
- [Timing and dose matter: a diurnal pattern of coffee consumption optimises improvement in insulin resistance](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Timing-and-dose-matter-a-diurnal-pattern-of-coffee-consumption-optimises-improvement,213786,0,2.html): Research on coffee consumption timing and insulin resistance
- [Global burden and cross-country inequalities of ischemic heart disease from 1990 to 2021](https://www.archivesofmedicalscience.com/Global-burden-and-cross-country-inequalities-of-ischemic-heart-disease-from-1990,211151,0,2.html): Global epidemiology analysis of ischemic heart disease burden and inequalities
